meta.authority: REVIEW.md §8.2 decision, 2026-08-18: supersede v0.1 with an as-built plan whose deviations are recorded as ADRs. Recorded in ADR-0018; boundary decisions in ADR-0019 (single Function App), ADR-0020 (native Terraform root module), ADR-0021 (Container Apps CI runner).
meta.describes: The environment implemented by infra/*.tf and verified live by the 2026-08-18 resource validation pass (Wiki: Resource-Validation-Report). This document records what exists; deviations still requiring remediation are tracked as TODO.md items and are marked remediationTracked below rather than ratified. T-503–T-506 hardening applied 2026-08-18; verification evidence in the Resource-Validation-Report addendum.

inputs.userGoal: Migrate the complete hybridcloudworks.com workload from Personal-Site_HCW into this repository using a cost-conscious, five-pillar Azure architecture, Terraform, and GitHub-first delivery. (v0.1 additionally specified Azure Verified Modules; superseded by ADR-0020 — native azurerm resources in a flat root module.)
subGoals: Cost-conscious production foundation with a USD 150 monthly budget ceiling and one production workload state.
Security-first admin plane using Microsoft Entra ID, managed identities, least privilege, and no static Azure credentials.
Static-first public delivery with measurable reliability and a staged Firebase-to-Azure rollback boundary.
insightsApplied: 2026-08-18 Resource-Validation-Report: external surface verified (edge live, TLS healthy, same-origin topology confirmed by DNS); plan-vs-code parity comparison is the source of every deviation disposition in this version.
Operator smoke run 2026-08-14: deployed anonymous surface, admin guards, CORS and health verified end-to-end from a residential IP.

reasoning.whyChosen: Single resource group for the single production workload state (ADR-0009). The seven-tag contract is the allocation and future-ALZ interface.
reasoning.deviationsFromV01: Name is as-built (v0.1 planned rg-hcw-prod). All resource names in this plan are the deployed names; the CAF -9x7k scheme was never implemented and renaming live resources is destroy/create. Ratified by ADR-0018.

reasoning.whyChosen: Workspace-based telemetry backing Application Insights; 30-day retention fits the cost ceiling.

properties.shared: one component for the whole workload

reasoning.whyChosen: One shared component follows from the single-app boundary (ADR-0019); per-boundary components were a consequence of the superseded three-app split.
reasoning.remediationTracked: T-505 APPLIED 2026-08-18: action group and diagnostic settings live; alert rules follow separately.

properties.topology: Same-origin: the SPA and /api are served from the apex host behind Cloudflare (confirmed by DNS: www and api-azure do not resolve).
properties.customDomains: Managed operationally, not in Terraform; only the TXT validation record is code (see Cloudflare entry).

reasoning.whyChosen: Standard tier for custom domain, SPA routing and staging environments (ADR-0007).

resources.name: hcw-cosmos-prod

properties.containers: 71 (generated from scripts/lib/migration-manifest.mjs, one per Firestore collection) + leases
properties.partitionKeys: 62 on /id; four flattened subcollections keyed by parent (documented in the manifest header with file:line evidence)
properties.networkRules: VNet filter: Functions subnet + Azure-datacenter sentinel + operator windows (applied 2026-08-18)

reasoning.whyChosen: Serverless capacity, container-per-collection and the per-container partition keys are three mutually load-bearing irreversible decisions, documented at the resource (ADR-0003; main.tf:89-111). Idle containers cost nothing on serverless; the 1:1 shape carries the migration verification story. v0.1's containerDesignGate is satisfied by the manifest's per-container query-contract evidence; ratified by ADR-0018.
reasoning.remediationTracked: T-504 APPLIED 2026-08-18. App path implied healthy by the cold-start check; the GitHub-runner path (0.0.0.0 sentinel) is UNVERIFIED because heal-computed-properties fails at Azure login — the CLIENT_ID/TENANT_ID/SUBSCRIPTION_ID repo variables were never set (pre-existing gap, CHECKLIST §7). Verify the sentinel with one green heal run after the variables are set. REVIEW §0.2 rotation history question stands.

Blob versioning and container soft delete from v0.1 remain unimplemented; acceptable while the migration source retains the authoritative copy (ADR-0016), revisit at Firebase decommission.
reasoning.remediationTracked: sharedKeyAccessEnabled remains provider-default true; disable alongside T-504's identity-only sweep if nothing key-based remains.

properties.networkRules: default Deny; Functions integration subnet; bypass AzureServices; per-run workflow + operator windows (applied 2026-08-18)

reasoning.remediationTracked: T-503 APPLIED AND VERIFIED 2026-08-18: default-Deny live; operator cold-start invocation passed, proving the VNet runtime/package-pull path. Workflow-deploy firewall window untested until deploy-functions.yml is enabled with its repo variables.

reasoning.whyChosen: Spoke-in-waiting for later ALZ hub peering; nothing assumes tenant-root placement.
reasoning.deviationsFromV01: v0.1 declared serviceEndpoints: [] — the implementation is correct and the plan was wrong: without Microsoft.KeyVault the vault's VNet rule is inert (documented at the subnet). T-503 adds Microsoft.Storage; T-504 adds Microsoft.AzureCosmosDB.

resources.name: hybridcloudworks-asp-prod / hcw-functions-prod
resources.subtype: Single Flex Consumption plan and Function App

properties.identity: SystemAssigned managed identity; all data-plane access via RBAC
properties.deployment: functionAppConfig.deployment pulls from function-releases via identity
properties.workScheduling: Timer/queue work runs in the same app behind per-timer feature flags (FEATURE_FLAG_*), master kill switch FEATURE_FLAG_SCHEDULERS

reasoning.whyChosen: One app, one identity, one deployment artifact — ADR-0019 supersedes the three-app split of ADR-0004: at this workload's scale the operational cost of three pipelines exceeded the isolation benefit, and the labs trust boundary moved into the API contract (agent certificate credentials, three-endpoint surface — REVIEW §0.4).
reasoning.deviationsFromV01: zoneRedundant=false ratified by ADR-0018 (amends the zone-aware posture of ADR-0011 for compute): enabling later forces a two-instance floor against the cost ceiling; single-region recovery is redeploy-from-code.

properties.networkAcls: Deny; allow Functions subnet; bypass AzureServices; admin_ip_rules seeding window (empty steady state)
properties.secretValues: Never managed by Terraform; seeded by hand during an admin_ip_rules window

reasoning.whyChosen: Matches v0.1 in every respect except purge protection.
reasoning.remediationTracked: purge_protection_enabled must be flipped true (TFC variable + apply) BEFORE the first production secret is seeded — Deployment Runbook §6; it is one-way.

reasoning.whyChosen: The USD 150 ceiling is ADR-0015 and holds.

properties.keyExposure: key output deleted (PR #108); Function App identity holds Cognitive Services OpenAI User

reasoning.whyChosen: Provisioning ratified retroactively by ADR-0018 (v0.1 and ADR-0013 feature-gated it pending capacity/content-filter/budget approvals that were overtaken by implementation). AI remains non-critical-path per ADR-0013.
reasoning.remediationTracked: T-506 APPLIED 2026-08-18: account replaced with subdomain endpoint, keys off, RBAC grant live, key output gone.

properties.roleAssignments: Website Contributor (deploy), Storage Blob Data Contributor on function-releases, Cosmos Data Contributor scoped to exactly the content and blogs containers (heal-computed-properties)

reasoning.whyChosen: A UAMI with federated credentials is creatable by Azure Owner without Entra directory roles (documented in oidc.tf); no static cloud credentials exist anywhere.
reasoning.deviationsFromV01: v0.1's separate read-only plan identity and protected-production-environment subject are not implemented; plan/apply separation is provided by HCP Terraform (VCS plan + human apply confirmation) instead. Ratified by ADR-0018 with a revisit trigger: if delivery moves out of TFC, the environment-subject model returns.

overallReasoning.summary: v0.2 records the environment as it exists and was validated on 2026-08-18. Structural deviations from v0.1 are decisions, each with an ADR: one Function App instead of three (ADR-0019), a flat native-provider Terraform root module instead of AVM composition (ADR-0020), the Container Apps CI runner (ADR-0021), and the umbrella ratification and disposition of everything else (ADR-0018). Security and observability gaps are deliberately NOT ratified: they are remediation debt tracked as TODO T-503/T-504/T-505/T-506 and remain deviations until closed.
overallReasoning.tradeoffs: The as-built system trades v0.1's defense-in-depth breadth (three identities, ZRS, zone redundancy, full alarm fabric) for operational simplicity and the USD 150 ceiling. The live environment carries data; every structural reconciliation toward v0.1 would now be state surgery, which is why ratification-with-tracked-debt was chosen over rework (REVIEW §8.2).

plan.validation: Validated as-built against infra/*.tf and the 2026-08-18 Resource-Validation-Report (external surface + full parity comparison). Not yet validated: an empty `terraform plan` against the hcw-azure workspace confirming zero drift between this document's source and deployed state — operator step, Deployment Runbook §4.
architecturePrinciples: Static first: public browsing does not depend on live database reads or AI availability.
Identity first: managed identity and Entra RBAC replace service keys wherever supported; remaining key paths are enumerated remediation debt (T-504, T-506), not accepted posture.
Least privilege by contract: one execution boundary whose privileged surfaces are constrained server-side per caller (supersedes v0.1's least-privilege-by-execution-boundary; ADR-0019).
Async side effects: external publishing and notifications are retry-safe, idempotent, observable, and poison-queue protected — partially implemented; queue fabric pending.
Cost is a design constraint: serverless capacity, lifecycle policies, tags, and the USD 150 budget are code; bounded telemetry is pending (T-505).
One reviewed artifact moves forward: GitHub plan, approval, apply, deployment, and rollback evidence remain connected through HCP Terraform and the gated delivery workflow.
Migration is reversible until acceptance gates pass; Firebase decommissioning is a separate approval.
